item.title: SolidCraft 0.49.0 changes from 0.48.1
item.description:
This diff is derived from the two checked canonical command registries:

  • 0.48.1: 866 commands, runtime v0.3.5;
  • 0.49.0: 886 commands, runtime v0.3.6.

The 0.49.0 registry adds 20 command ids, removes 0, and changes 35 existing definitions. Existing-definition changes are limited to params text/contracts and keyboard shortcut metadata; no existing command id disappeared.

Added commands

  • body.collision
  • body.remove_history
  • component.physical_override
  • construct.point.average
  • doc.info
  • file.export_urdf_options
  • file.revert_saved
  • frame.gusset
  • frame.trim
  • inspect.hole_stacks
  • joint.dynamics
  • joint.origin_frame
  • layout.delete
  • sheet.bead
  • sketch.export_svg
  • sketch.spline3d.control_point
  • timeline.roll_to_end
  • timeline.roll_to_start
  • timeline.step_back
  • timeline.step_forward

Existing command definitions changed

  • assembly.constraint.create
  • component.break_link
  • component.insert_design
  • component.paste_from_design
  • component.update_links
  • doc.open
  • doc.recover
  • drawing.dimension.add
  • drawing.dimension.edit
  • drawing.dimension.inspect
  • drawing.dimension.repair
  • drawing.sheet.set
  • file.export
  • file.export_3mf
  • file.export_obj
  • file.export_stl
  • file.export_urdf
  • file.insert_step
  • file.save
  • file.save_as
  • frame.member
  • inspect.clearance
  • joint.origin
  • parts.fastener
  • parts.insert
  • sheet.export_dxf
  • sketch.move
  • sketch.move3d
  • sketch.replace
  • solid.extrude
  • solid.move
  • surface.loft
  • surface.revolve
  • view.fit
  • view.home

Forge-relevant review

  • sheet.fold has no registry-contract change between 0.48.1 and 0.49.0. Forge #74 therefore continues to use the same native sketch + curve associative fold input that was qualified on the 0.49 candidate.
  • solid.extrude gains the documented to_body_apart option; existing Forge extrusion inputs remain present.
  • sheet.export_dxf documents formed-bead output in addition to the existing roles.
  • surface.loft and surface.revolve gain explicit facing controls.
  • Shortcut metadata changes include Sketch Move (M), Fit (End) and Home (Home).

The complete machine-readable diff remains the pair of checked commands.json files. This note records review conclusions; it is not a replacement for canonical registry evidence.
